summary: PR 971 is test-only hardening for fused-QKV logic already present on the recorded base. All six candidate tests pass unchanged on that base, so they do not reproduce or discriminate the original ModelSlim/Ascend accuracy failure. Independent synthetic layout checks passed, but the private checkpoint and reported Ascend topology were unavailable; the claim that the original issue is corrected remains unverified.

tests.what_was_measured: The exact candidate test content passed 6/6 before applying the candidate, demonstrating test-only hardening rather than a failing-before/passing-after regression.
The candidate's six synthetic unit cases passed at the exact reviewed commit.
Independent mapping across runtime TP 1/2/4/8 and all ranks, plus non-uniform block-scale association on CPU and AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950; all passed.

gpu_execution.evidence: The independent non-uniform scale fixture executed on AMD Instinct MI355X, gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-, and recovered [1,1,3.000000238,3.000000238,2,4,2,4] against [1,1,3,3,2,4,2,4]. This validates only synthetic tensor arithmetic, not Ascend execution or model accuracy.

remaining_counterexamples: The candidate's complete regression suite passes on the recorded base commit, despite the original issue remaining open; it therefore cannot demonstrate that the candidate fixes the reported failure.
No test loads the reported MiMo-V2.5-Pro-W8A8 ModelSlim checkpoint or independently confirms its real tensor names, shapes, ordering, and scale metadata.
No test measures generated-token or semantic accuracy on MiMo-V2.5-Pro-W8A8.
No test executes the Ascend/CANN load and serving path or the reported two-node TP32/DP4 topology.
remaining_limitations: The private reported checkpoint was unavailable.
Ascend 910 hardware and CANN 9.1 were unavailable.
Only one AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950 GPU was assigned; no multi-node or 64-device reproduction was possible.
The candidate changed no production/native source; no native rebuild was applicable.
The prepared checkout exactly matched the recorded base commit.
